craft_notes: Sthāyin: śānta-adbhuta of rested-emitted — peace inside wonder; rest-and-publish song. Self-stamped; measure-limits-seeing; fine-indeed close. Rejected: (a) limits→limit → killed: plural exact. Read aloud: SELF-stamped … AND-se-QUENCE, FINE in-DEED.

lines: Self-stamped from such a state — two states gone before, too —
Māyā-measured, limits may see — and sequence, fine indeed.
l4.sanskrit_cite: svavāsanātādavasthyād daśayoḥ pūrvayor api māyāmātur mitatvaṃ syāt paśyantyāś ca kramo hy aṇuḥ
